text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both grinding modestly higher, with ETH outpacing BTC's gains—a sign some traders are rotating into altcoins despite overall caution. The Fear & Greed index at 29 reflects genuine market anxiety, though its recent 4-point rise suggests sentiment may be stabilizing after a deeper dip. Bitcoin dominance holding firm at 56.3% alongside $51B in daily volume indicates measured activity rather than panic liquidation, pointing to a consolidation phase where conviction remains thin but panic selling has eased.
